experiment: E2 -- the fold in SU(2) and SU(3) (Skyrme hedgehog, rigid-rotor quantisation)
conventions: L = (F_pi^2/16) Tr dU dU^dag + (1/(32 e^2)) Tr[L_mu,L_nu]^2, F_pi in the 186-MeV convention (f_pi = F_pi/2), x = e F_pi r, massless pions, hedgehog F(0) = pi, F ~ C/x^2

headline.source: PLAN E2 [read: Schechter-Weigel hep-ph/9907554, Praszalowicz hep-ph/0308114]: 36.5 F_pi/e = 1.2315 x 3pi^2

headline.source: PLAN E2 (ANW numbers via secondary sources)

headline.quantity: g_A at the ANW fit (SU(2), -(pi/(3e^2)) D)
headline.source: PLAN E2; formula read in Acus et al. hep-ph/9605435 eqs. 4.9-4.10 (ANW column 0.61)
headline.note: D = -17.277156 = -2C exactly. This formula is 3/2 of the ball integral of the Noether axial current (the q->0 transverse form factor with a massless pion pole); the bare ball integral gives 0.407. PDG 2026 g_A = 1.2754: the model is -52%

headline.quantity: I2 coefficient (pi/2) J2, I2 = coef/(e^3 F_pi)
headline.source: PLAN E2 [read: Praszalowicz eq. 28, arctan ansatz; formula Kopeliovich hep-th/9707067 eq. 22c]
headline.note: J2 = 25.896790; arctan ansatz recomputed: 40.5435 (exact is +0.33% above it); I1/I2 = 2.62471. I2 formula derived from U = A U0 A^dag with explicit SU(3) matrices (max rel. dev. 5e-15)
exact rational arithmetic; 293.0 MeV (ANW set), 230.9 MeV (SU(3) refit)
also 5.6e-13 from an independent quadrature; E(mu) minimum at mu* = 1.000000000

headline.quantity: von Laue: int d^3x p / int d^3x |p|
headline.note: single pressure node at x = 2.1522, p > 0 inside; stress tensor verified against the Noether T_ij

headline.target: no minimum without the Skyrme term
headline.note: scaling law verified by quadrature to 2e-15

headline.value: holds for N_c = 1..7 (all irreps p+q <= 16) and N_c <= 15 (p+q <= 30)
headline.target: J half-integer exactly when N_c odd

seed_claims.claim: SEED §2: for SU(3) the Wess-Zumino term makes the fold a fermion when N_c is odd (Witten 1983)
seed_claims.evidence: With the WZ constraint Y_R = N_c B/3 (taken from the literature, not derived here), every allowed state has 2J = N_c mod 2 for N_c = 1..15; lowest states listed for N_c = 1..7

seed_claims.claim: SEED §4: in 3D a static fold cannot be held by gradient energy alone (Derrick); something must push back
seed_claims.evidence: E2[F(mu x)] = E2/mu exactly (quadrature, 2e-15); the sigma-model radial ODE has no solution reaching F = 0 (ends at pi/2); with the Skyrme term E2 = E4 to 6e-13 and int p d^3x = 0

seed_claims.claim: SEED §6B: quantizing the hedgehog's rotations, the lowest states fill the octet and the decuplet (Guadagnini 1984)
seed_claims.evidence: Lowest allowed (Y_R = 1) states are 8 (J=1/2) and 10 (J=3/2); the same rotor also predicts exotic 10bar (J=1/2) and 27 at E(8) + 3/(2I2) and above (about 1760 MeV at the SU(3) refit), which the seed does not mention

seed_claims.claim: SEED §6B: with exact SU(3) every member of a multiplet has one mass; the splittings need a symmetry-breaking term with more parameters
seed_claims.evidence: All d_R(2J+1) rotor states of 8, 10, 10bar are degenerate (explicit matrices). Optional first-order H' = -alpha D88 + beta Y needs 2 fitted inputs; it reproduces the 8 PDG multiplets with rms 4 MeV and implies GMO, equal spacing and Guadagnini's relation (PDG: +0.04%)

seed_claims.claim: SEED §6B: F sets the units and e is the only pure number, so every prediction is a ratio
seed_claims.evidence: M = 36.46 F_pi/e, I = coef/(e^3 F_pi), g_A = 18.09/e^2: every dimensionless observable is a function of e alone (massless pions)

seed_claims.claim: SEED §6B: for nucleons the model lands within roughly 30% (ANW 1983)
seed_claims.evidence: Masses are fit inputs. Of the E2 observables, g_A = 0.61 vs 1.2754 (PDG 2026) is 52% low, outside 30%; in the SU(3)-symmetric rotor it drops further by 7/10. The other static properties are E5's job
